test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 02 Dec, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question:
Read the below statements and select the correct option with respect to self-help groups.

(i) A self-help group is a registered group of micro-entrepreneurs.

(ii) The micro-entrepreneurs of self-help groups have similar social and economic backgrounds.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only (ii) is true**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Self-help groups (SHGs) are typically informal groups of people who come together for a common purpose, often related to financial or social improvement.
 
• SHGs are usually composed of individuals who share similar social and economic backgrounds, facilitating mutual understanding and support.
 
• These groups are often focused on micro-entrepreneurship, where members contribute to a common fund and can take small loans from it.
 
• SHGs are not always formally registered but operate on trust and mutual benefit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Self-Help Groups (SHGs)**

 
 
• Self-help groups are small voluntary associations of people, preferably from the same socio-economic background.
 
• They come together for the purpose of solving their common problems through self-help and mutual help.
 
• SHGs are often focused on micro-financing, where members contribute to a common fund and can take small loans from it at reasonable interest rates.
 
• They play a crucial role in the social and economic empowerment of individuals, especially women in rural areas.
 
 
 
• **Micro-entrepreneurs**
 
 
• Micro-entrepreneurs are individuals who operate very small businesses, often with minimal capital investment and few employees.
 
• These businesses are usually informal and operate on a small scale, but they provide essential goods and services to their communities.
 
• Micro-entrepreneurship is a key component of SHGs, as it allows members to improve their livelihoods through small-scale business activities.
 
 
 
• **Registration of SHGs**
 
 
• While some SHGs may choose to register formally with local authorities or organizations, many operate informally.
 
• Registration can provide SHGs with greater access to resources, government schemes, and financial services.
 
• However, the informal nature of many SHGs allows for greater flexibility and ease of operation.
